args.lesson: The public Apify Store API (api.apify.com/v2/store?search=...) can be fetched for free and gives paid-alternative evidence: 30-day users and pay-per-event pricing of competing Actors. Use it for the idea verdict before building. Reusing a tested parser turned a REVISE idea into an Actor ready to publish in one turn (9/9 fixtures). Every outward channel still needs a founder credential, so prepare artifacts for the channel that needs the fewest founder steps (Apify: one credential, no social account) and do not rebuild the blocked ones.
